title: Start of the Coming Authorization Period for an Insured Plan of Care Extension
content:
When the period an Insured Plan of Care extension request covers starts depends on the current authorization:

| Current authorization on today's date | The period starts |
|---|---|
| Still in force on today's date with approved visits not yet drawn | The day after its end date |
| No authorization in force on today's date, and the plan's booked Appointment Series starts later | On that series' start date |
| Otherwise | Today |

An authorization is in force on today's date when today falls within its approval's first and last covered dates.

## Hypothetical cases (today 2026-05-05)

1. Current authorization covers 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-20, 12 visits approved, 9 drawn: the period starts 2026-05-21.
2. Current authorization covered 2026-03-01 to 2026-04-30; the plan's booked Appointment Series starts 2026-05-12: the period starts 2026-05-12.
3. Current authorization covers 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-20 with all 12 approved visits drawn: the period starts today, 2026-05-05.
4. Current authorization covered 2026-03-01 to 2026-04-30 and the plan has no booked series starting later: the period starts today.
